Agent Island v0.12.0 rebuilds the Windows application with native WPF and .NET 8.

### Native rebuild

- No embedded Electron or Chromium in the new application.
- Reusable Work, Todos, and Clipboard pages with transform-based transitions and the original animated companion.
- Background Codex session parsing, 5-hour/weekly quota display, local hooks and permission decisions, edge placement, and auto-hide.
- Shared settings and todos with the previous Electron version. Exit the old app before starting the native app; update old shortcuts/startup entries.
- Hidden decorative animations stop. Short diagnostic samples are not a promise of zero dropped frames or a long-term memory ceiling.

### Choose your download

- **self-contained ZIP (recommended):** includes the .NET desktop runtime.
- **framework-dependent ZIP:** smaller; requires .NET 8 Desktop Runtime x64.

Extract the whole archive and run `AgentIsland.Native.exe`. Keep all accompanying files. Verify its matching `.sha256` file. Windows builds are unsigned and may show an unknown-publisher warning.

### Changes and privacy

- Send to Notion is removed. The native quota display does not currently expose the previous Credits/context fields.
- Fresh installs keep notification capture and removal off; saved choices are preserved. Clipboard capture starts only after the first-run choice and remains in memory.
- Diagnostic screenshots use synthetic tasks and quotas without scanning real sessions or capturing clipboard/notification contents.
- The API is loopback-only and rejects browser Origin requests. Other local programs can still access task/event text and submit decisions; it is not an authentication boundary.
- No telemetry, remote logging, cloud account, or automatic upload was added. Windows toast suppression remains a system setting.

The previous v0.11.3 Electron release remains available for rollback. Please sanitize logs and screenshots before sharing bug reports.
